touchpoints.finding: CharacterSheetMove.contestStats is an optional free-form compatibility field. It is copied/cleared with move lookup fields but has no canonical parsing, validation, or mechanics.
Pokémon sheets have no structured contest-stat or Poffin state.
Playing God coloration already uses beauty/cool/cute/smart/tough IDs and carries immutable source evidence.
The app-owned move catalog had no contest type/effect fields; documentary Move blocks were not runtime authority.
Contest mechanics existed only as documentary prose and a conflicting Useful Charts center-scoring row.
Exactly 34 reviewed Feature rows comprise the Coordinator tree, Style Expert tree, and seven crossover rows; existing automation does not expose contest timing.
Grace and Groomer have no contest runtime despite canonical prose.
Beautiful has dormant contest metadata in automation mechanics, while Beautiful, Fashion Designer, and Ugly have no complete contest lifecycle integration.
Poffin Mixer, Fancy Clothes, Contest Accessory, and Contest Fashion were prose-only; standalone Poffin identity was absent.
No ContestDocument, lifecycle, dice journal, projection, realtime, UI, or settlement path existed.
